title: Managed Backup: withdrawal and termination
content:
For Managed Backup, the withdrawal and termination basis governs application withdrawal, active-contract closure, suspended-contract closure.

## Policy clauses

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources.

An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge.

For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the fixed handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time.

Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits.

On-demand termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules.

If a signed commitment remains unexpired and permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on customer termination is false, invoice its recorded remaining contractual liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability.

No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible.

Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect.

Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies the remaining contractual liability in USD; that liability is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains.

A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Authoritative evidence

Before application withdrawal, active-contract closure, suspended-contract closure, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Customer request reference, Original source reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The customer performs withdrawal from applied to closed, or closure from active or suspended to closed.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical withdrawal, the contract is still applied. The customer may withdraw it without setup, usage or termination charges. In a separate hypothetical closure with positive recorded unbilled commitment liability, that liability requires its distinct termination entry using the disposal request as source.
